title: fleet-guards: no validation of CYCLE_MIN — 0/negative arg causes hot loop hammering bd + credits API
description: Codereview of 2ehk (edge pass, kimi-k3). fleet-guards.sh:10,122: 'fleet-guards.sh 0' or a negative numeric arg makes sleep return instantly/fail -> hot loop hammering bd list and the OpenRouter credits API back-to-back. Non-numeric input already dies noisily under set -u (safe). One-line guard at startup: require CYCLE_MIN >= 1.
close_reason: Fixed: startup guard at fleet-guards.sh — CYCLE_MIN must match a positive integer (case pattern rejects empty, non-numeric, and 0/negative); prints a named error to stderr and exits 1 before any loop or API call. Verified: '0', '-3', 'abc' all exit 1 with the message; bash -n clean.
